personal.name: YOUR_NAME
bio: I build Android apps the way good software should be built — fast, tested and a pleasure to use. I sweat the small stuff: animation curves, empty states, offline behaviour, and that last 5% of polish most people skip.
Currently shipping production Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, Coroutines & Flow and Clean Architecture. When I'm not debugging, I'm writing about Android or pushing open source.

hero.subtitle: I'm Your Name — an Android developer building fast, clean, human-centred Kotlin apps. Jetpack Compose to release-ready APKs, and everything in between.

skills.title: Languages
skills.desc: Kotlin-first, Java legacy, coroutines & Flow, generics, DSL design.

skills.title: UI / Compose
skills.desc: Jetpack Compose, Material 3, custom animations, adaptive layouts.

skills.title: Data & Network
skills.desc: Room, Retrofit, Ktor, DataStore, offline-first caching.

skills.title: Architecture
skills.desc: MVVM, Clean Architecture, Hilt DI, multi-module builds.

skills.title: Quality
skills.desc: Unit / UI tests, TDD, Compose testing, Firebase Test Lab.

skills.title: Ship & Grow
skills.desc: Play Store release, CI/CD, analytics, performance profiling.

experience.desc: Leading the Android app for a 1M+ user product. Compose-first rewrite, CI/CD rollout, 40% crash reduction.
Shipped 8 apps across fintech, fitness and e-commerce. Owned architecture, releases and Play Store uplift.
Built MVPs and hobby apps end-to-end. Learned to ship things people actually use.

projects.title: E-Commerce App
projects.desc: Full storefront with checkout flow, Room cart and push-notification re-engagement.
projects.longDesc: A complete e-commerce experience built with Jetpack Compose. Features a product catalogue with search and filtering, shopping cart persisted via Room, Stripe payment integration, order tracking with real-time status updates, and FCM push notifications for abandoned cart recovery and promotional campaigns.

projects.title: Fitness Tracker
projects.desc: Compose-native tracker with live charts, streaks and offline workout sync.
projects.longDesc: Personal fitness companion with real-time workout tracking, calorie and macro logging, progress charts powered by a custom Compose Canvas renderer, daily streak system, and offline-first sync with Firestore. Health Connect integration for step and heart-rate data.

projects.title: News Reader
projects.desc: Offline-first RSS client with reader mode and smart background fetch.
projects.longDesc: Minimal RSS reader with offline caching via Room, WorkManager background sync, reader mode for clean article viewing, dark/light theme, and bookmark system. Supports feed discovery and custom OPML import.

projects.title: Chat App
projects.desc: Real-time messaging with Firebase, read receipts and media sharing.
projects.longDesc: End-to-end real-time chat application using Firebase Realtime Database with one-to-one and group messaging, image and voice note sharing, read receipts, typing indicators, push notifications, and user presence status.

projects.title: Weather Dashboard
projects.desc: Beautiful weather UI with animated icons and 7-day forecast.
projects.longDesc: A polished weather dashboard featuring animated weather icons in Lottie, current conditions with location-based auto-detect, 7-day and hourly forecasts, air quality index, sunrise/sunset times, and a clean Material 3 design system.

projects.title: Budget Tracker
projects.desc: Personal finance app with category breakdown and recurring expense sync.
projects.longDesc: Personal finance tracker with expense and income logging, category breakdown with donut charts, monthly budget goals with alerts, recurring transaction scheduling, CSV export, and local-first storage via Room with optional cloud backup.

projects.title: Music Player
projects.desc: Material You media player with playlist queue and lyrics overlay.
projects.longDesc: A full-featured local music player with Media3 integration, Material You dynamic theming from album art, playlist management, crossfade, gapless playback, lyrics overlay synced to playback position, and a lockscreen notification controller.

projects.title: Recipe Hub
projects.desc: Recipe sharing PWA with search, filters and save-to-collection.
projects.longDesc: A progressive web app for recipe discovery and sharing. Features full-text search, dietary and cuisine filters, step-by-step cooking mode, save to collections, and a clean responsive design built with React and Tailwind.

projects.title: Compose Toolkit
projects.desc: Open-source Compose utility library with 15+ reusable components.
projects.longDesc: A collection of production-ready Jetpack Compose components: animated loading skeletons, bottom sheet system, custom slider, shimmer effects, permission handling, and pagination helpers. Published to Maven Central with 200+ GitHub stars.

projects.title: Portfolio Generator
projects.desc: CLI tool that generates portfolio sites from a JSON config file.
projects.longDesc: A Node.js CLI tool that scaffolds a complete developer portfolio from a single JSON config file. Supports multiple themes, auto-deploys to GitHub Pages, and includes Lighthouse performance optimization out of the box.
